footer.tagline: Anyị na-eweghachi ugwu, na-emepụta ohere, ma na-ewetakwa olileanya — site n'ọrụ.

hero.description: Ọtụtụ nde ndị na-enweghị ihe ha kwesịrị enweta ka na-enweghị ohere ịnweta ahụike, agụmakwụkwọ na ohere. CHADI na-agbanwe nke a — otu ndụ, otu obodo n'otu oge.

aboutPreview.title: Ịmepụta Mmetụta Na-adịgide Adịgide N'ime Obodo
aboutPreview.p1: CHADI International bụ ọrụ ebumnobi na-arụghị ọrụ maka uru onwe ya nke raara onwe ya nye ịkwalite ndụ site n'agụmakwụkwọ, ahụike, mmepụta ọhụrụ, mmekọrịta gburugburu na-adịgide adịgide, enyemaka mmadụ na ikike ndị na-eto eto.
aboutPreview.p2: Anyị kwenyere na mgbanwe na-adịgide adịgide na-eme mgbe obodo ghọrọ ndị sonyeere n'ọrụ maka mmepe nke onwe ha.
